analysis.reason: 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 과매도 구간 탈출 후 중립 구간에서 횡보 중. MACD 히스토그램은 개선세를 보이나 여전히 음수 구간. ADX는 32.3으로 뚜렷한 추세 강도를 보이나, -DI가 +DI보다 우위에 있어 하락 압력 우위. 5일 평균 대비 거래량 비율 0.79로 위축된 거래량은 방향성 부재 시사. 현재가 88,905원은 스윙 저항선 89,580원 하단에 위치하며, 스윙 지지선 85,300원 상단에 있어 뚜렷한 방향성 부재.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI has exited oversold territory and is consolidating in the neutral zone. MACD histogram shows improvement but remains negative. ADX indicates a strong trend at 32.3, but -DI is above +DI, suggesting downward pressure. Volume ratio of 0.79 to the 5-day average signals subdued activity. Current price at 88,905 is below the swing resistance of 89,580 and above the swing support of 85,300, indicating a lack of clear direction.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price 88,905 vs SMA5 87,645 (above), SMA20 97,995 (below): weakening short-term momentum, below mid-term trend.
· Significantly below SMA100 112,254 and SMA200 100,233: long-term trend weakness.
· 52-week position 35.5%: attempting to rebound from near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI 27.4 → 36.5 (exiting oversold): confirming weak rebound momentum.
· MACD histogram -2406.4506 → -963.6675 (improving): signal of slowing decline, potential bottoming.
· Bollinger Band current price 88,905, below mid-band 97,995: approaching lower band, wide band width at 41.79%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support 85,300: near 52-week low and Pivot S1.
· Swing resistance 89,580: near 5-day high and Pivot PP, potential short-term rebound if broken.
· 5-day high 91,390, low 83,045; 20-day high 112,870, low 83,045: confirming sideways pattern.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio 0.79: subdued volume suggests lack of directional conviction.
· Current phase diagnosis: Accumulation: RSI exiting oversold and MACD improvement are positive, but lack of volume and trading below weekly SMA20 warrant a wait-and-see approach.
